key_insight: Q-Capsule reduces barren-plateau effects by localizing quantum capsules, limiting entanglement, and growing circuit depth adaptively with QFIM guidance.
engineering_relevance: The design offers a more trainable and gate-efficient quantum neural architecture for practical variational learning on larger registers under noise and measurement constraints.
method: Partition qubits into local capsules with localized readout
Use sparse inter-capsule coupling plus trainable data re-uploading
Adapt circuit depth using QFIM-based growth policy
evidence_signal: Compared with globally entangling baselines, Q-Capsule maintains stable gradient variance as width increases and achieves 98.1% binary and 97.7% four-class accuracy, while using about 73% fewer two-qubit gates on the multiclass task.
watch_item: Performance may depend on careful capsule partitioning and QFIM-driven depth control, which could add design complexity and require extra tuning.
paper_title: Q-Capsule: A Localized Capsule-Based Quantum Neural Architecture for Barren Plateau Mitigation
